title: mimid-chat: base_room_policy command, and an Add plus base_room_policy change in one Commit
description:
For the IETF 127 table test Jason (Haven) asked about (Zulip #mimi 237955; our reading posted as 237963): can one Commit carry a participant-list change and a room-policy change? -07 §7.5 allows several ParticipantListUpdates per Commit. room-policy-04 §3 forbids roles_list beside any participant change, and §4 forbids preauth_list beside one except removals. §5 base_room_policy has no such rule. So 'participant change + base_room_policy' is valid as written, while mimi-hubd refuses any second change (Haven DIV-10).

Add to tools/interop/chat:
1. /policy <field>=<value> ... : a Commit with one AppDataUpdate for base_room_policy (component 0x0027 per Haven's vectors; check against mimi_room_policy::component_id). It replaces the room's BaseRoomPolicy (mimi_room_policy::BaseRoomPolicy: fixed_membership, parent_dependant, parent_room, multi_device, max_clients, max_users, ...), starting from the room's current value so unchanged fields carry over.
2. /invite <user> --policy <field>=<value>: the usual Add plus ParticipantListUpdate, with the base_room_policy AppDataUpdate in the same Commit.
3. A third form with roles_list in place of base_room_policy, for the negative case: both hubs should refuse it (room-policy-04 §3; mimid hub Denied::PolicyMixedWithParticipantChange).

Checks: our acceptance run against haven.reviewcommit.com, plus a case against mimid's own hub logic if one is cheap. Expected on mimi.havenmessenger.com today: the combined Commit is refused as a second change (DIV-10); that is the finding to report. mimi-hubd doesn't check roles yet, so this tests only the one-change rule. Only run it on Jason's hub after he agrees in #mimi.
